name: martebizuteria
description: Full-stack e-commerce platform for M'Arte Jewellery. High-performance storefront & admin dashboard built with TanStack Start and React. Luxury UX via GSAP & Lenis. Styled with Tailwind & Shadcn UI. Powered by Cloudflare Workers, D1, R2, and KV. Internationalized with use-intl.

scripts.clean: rm -rf dist .wrangler .tanstack coverage playwright-report test-results blob-report .bun-cache
scripts.clean:hardcore: bun run clean:deep && rm -rf bun.lock opensrc
scripts.db:migrate: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply martebizuteria-preview --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply martebizuteria --remote
scripts.db:seed: vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria-preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-categories.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria-preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-collections.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria-preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-attributes.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria-preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/products.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria-preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-variants.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria-preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/inventory.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria-preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-images.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria-preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/category-on-product.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria-preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/collection-on-product.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria-preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/attribute-on-product.sql
scripts.db:seed:production: vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-categories.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-collections.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-attributes.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/products.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-variants.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/inventory.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-images.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/category-on-product.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/collection-on-product.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute martebizuteria --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/attribute-on-product.sql
scripts.deploy:production: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production vp build && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:preview: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preview vp build && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
